description: Canonical vendor-neutral onboarding and bootstrap package for Iceberg Playbook.

playbooks.name: Getting Started
playbooks.description: Canonical onboarding procedures and baseline operational workflows for the Iceberg Support Playbook system.

sops.title: How to Use Playbooks
sops.purpose: Provide a comprehensive guide on navigating, understanding, and organizing domain-specific Playbooks for customer support and operational procedures.
sops.whenToUse: When onboarding new support agents or setting up a new service line that requires structured operational knowledge grouping.
requirements: Active access to the Iceberg Support Playbook portal
checklist: Locate target Playbook by code or name

steps.title: Navigate the Playbook Directory
steps.description: Open the Playbooks catalog from the main navigation. Browse available functional playbooks or filter by name to find the domain corresponding to the customer inquiry.
steps.importantNote: Playbooks group all operational materials: common issues, solution guides, and standard operating procedures for each domain.
steps.successIndicator: The target Playbook overview page is loaded, displaying key statistics and child content.

steps.title: Review Playbook Metadata and Scope
steps.description: Examine the playbook description, owner, responsible team, and assigned prefix code. Confirm that the current customer incident or operational request matches the stated scope.
steps.successIndicator: Confirmed scope matches the customer inquiry.

steps.title: Select Related Operational Content
steps.description: Drill down into specific Issues for diagnostic troubleshooting, Guides for customer-facing instructions, or SOPs for operational execution.
steps.successIndicator: Relevant guide or SOP is identified and opened for execution.

sops.escalationRules: If a requested operational domain lacks an existing Playbook, escalate to the Support Operations Lead via the team channel with the proposed scope and subject-matter owners.
sops.completionCriteria: The agent understands the playbook structure, can locate relevant materials by domain code, and knows where to seek assistance.
sops.internalNotes: Playbooks are intended to be living domain hubs. Keep owners updated quarterly.

sops.title: How to Use Issues
sops.purpose: Establish the standard workflow for searching, diagnosing, and logging operational issues encountered by support teams and customers.
sops.whenToUse: When triaging inbound incident tickets or classifying symptom patterns reported by users.
requirements: Active ticket context or customer bug report
Read access to the relevant domain Playbook
checklist: Capture exact error message and symptoms
Search for matching existing issue code

steps.title: Extract Symptoms and Error Details
steps.description: Collect user error messages, environment details, timestamps, and reproduction steps from the inbound customer ticket.
steps.importantNote: Do not alter customer-provided error strings; search exact codes first.
steps.successIndicator: Exact error text and reproducible steps are logged in the ticket.

steps.title: Search and Match Known Issue Records
steps.description: Use global search or the Playbook issue list to match the symptom pattern. Compare the information-to-collect checklist against the customer submission.
steps.successIndicator: Matching issue record found with verified symptoms.

steps.title: Execute Linked Resolution or Escalate
steps.description: Open the primary Guide attached to the Issue to resolve the incident. If no existing Issue matches, follow the new issue intake protocol.
steps.successIndicator: Resolution guide opened or new issue draft initiated.

sops.escalationRules: If customer symptoms match an existing critical issue but the linked guide fails, escalate immediately to Tier 2 Engineering on-call.
sops.completionCriteria: Ticket is linked to the correct Issue record and troubleshooting steps are underway.
sops.internalNotes: Issue records should be reviewed periodically to deprecate resolved defects.

sops.title: How to Use Guides
sops.purpose: Standardize how agents follow, verify, and reference step-by-step resolution guides for customer incidents.
sops.whenToUse: When providing step-by-step customer troubleshooting instructions or performing guided technical fixes.
requirements: Identified target Issue or Guide title
Agent workspace or staging test environment
checklist: Confirm expected result at each step

steps.title: Review Prerequisites and Important Notes
steps.description: Before executing instructions, inspect the requirements, prerequisites, and warnings in the guide header to ensure all preconditions are satisfied.
steps.importantNote: Never skip prerequisites; doing so may cause cascading verification failures.
steps.successIndicator: All preconditions and necessary account permissions are verified.

steps.title: Execute Solution Steps Sequentially
steps.description: Follow each numbered step precisely. Verify intermediate results against the Expected Result indicator before proceeding to subsequent steps.
steps.successIndicator: All steps executed in order with expected outcomes verified.

steps.title: Consult Common Problems Accordion if Blocked
steps.description: If a step fails or produces an unexpected error, check the Common Problems section for documented edge cases, root causes, and workarounds.
steps.successIndicator: Workaround applied or blocker documented for escalation.

sops.escalationRules: If a verified Guide produces reproducible failure steps in a production customer tenant, flag the guide for review and escalate to the guide Author or Playbook Owner.
sops.completionCriteria: The customer problem is resolved or an accurate edge-case escalation is documented.
sops.internalNotes: Guides can be revised using version history to reflect platform UI changes.

sops.title: How to Use SOPs
sops.purpose: Guide support agents on executing and documenting repeatable operational procedures and internal workflows.
sops.whenToUse: When carrying out standard operational workflows (e.g. customer onboarding, credentials rotation, access provisioning, maintenance).
checklist: Verify process checklist items as work proceeds
Confirm completion criteria before closing ticket

steps.title: Inspect SOP Scope and When-to-Use Criteria
steps.description: Review the Purpose, When to Use, and Responsible Team sections to confirm this procedure applies to the customer scenario.
steps.importantNote: Do not use SOPs for exploratory debugging; use Guides and Issues instead.
steps.successIndicator: Confirmed operational task matches SOP criteria.

steps.title: Track Progress via the Process Checklist
steps.description: Use the interactive checklist at the top of the SOP to mark completed workflow stages in real time as actions are performed.
steps.successIndicator: All checklist items are completed and checked off.

steps.title: Verify Completion Criteria and Hand-off
steps.description: Ensure that all completion criteria defined in the SOP are satisfied before concluding the operational task or handing off to another team.
steps.successIndicator: All completion criteria met and documented in the ticket audit log.

sops.escalationRules: Follow the embedded Escalation Rules in the SOP if any prerequisite fails or SLA time exceeds the estimated threshold by 50%.
sops.completionCriteria: The procedure is completely executed in accordance with documented steps and verified against completion criteria.
sops.internalNotes: SOPs represent binding operational compliance. Changes require review.

sops.title: How to Manage Users
sops.purpose: Standard operating procedure for inviting team members, granting role-based permissions, and managing administrative access to the Support Playbook system.
sops.whenToUse: When provisioning new support staff, modifying user role assignments, or auditing administrative access privileges.
requirements: Two-factor authentication enabled on Admin account
checklist: Audit activation status in user roster

steps.title: Verify Access Request and Admin Privileges
steps.description: Confirm you are authenticated with an Admin role. Review the incoming access request ticket to verify manager approval and corporate email domain.
steps.importantNote: Admin-only procedure: Non-admin users cannot access the User Management panel.
steps.successIndicator: Valid approved request ticket verified with matching corporate identity.

steps.title: Generate and Dispatch Invitation
steps.description: Navigate to Admin > Users. Click 'Invite User', enter the user's corporate email and designated role (Support or Admin). Send the secure activation invitation.
steps.importantNote: Invitations expire after 48 hours for security. Only grant Admin role when explicitly authorized in the ticket.
steps.successIndicator: Invitation record appears in the Pending Invitations list.

steps.title: Monitor Account Activation and Role Compliance
steps.description: Confirm the user successfully activates their account via the secure activation link. Verify their assigned role in the active user roster and record the ticket completion.
steps.successIndicator: User status transitions from Pending to Active in the User Management console.

sops.escalationRules: If an unauthorized access attempt or privilege escalation request is detected, lock the target account and notify the Security Operations Center (SOC) immediately.
sops.completionCriteria: The user account is properly provisioned with least-privilege role assignment and logged in the administrative audit record.
sops.internalNotes: Strict compliance requirement: Quarterly user audits must reconcile all active accounts against HR employee rosters.
